notes: Supply finite multiplicity using the prime ideal and the already proved nonzero principal ideal. The definition ord_vw la I := multiplicity la.asIdeal I compiles unchanged, but the target Mathlib defines multiplicity a b as (emultiplicity a b).toNat, where the pinned Mathlib used (emultiplicity a b).untopD 1. The two differ only when the multiplicity is infinite. Since la.asIdeal is a nonzero prime, that happens only for I = ⊥, where ord_vw la ⊥ is now 0 instead of 1; for every nonzero ideal the value is unchanged. Every use of ord_vw in the archive applies it to a nonzero ideal (conjDifferent σ, nonzero by conjDifferent_ne_bot; Ideal.span {(n' : 𝓞 K)} with n' : ℕ+; or under an explicit I ≠ ⊥ hypothesis), so no statement that uses it changes meaning. No other exported declaration statements, definitions or instances changed.
